headline: President Prabowo Has Not Submitted Vice President Candidates Yet
seoTitle: Prabowo Has Not Proposed Vice President Candidates
metaDescription: The President has not submitted names for the vacant Vice President position to the MPR, as official requirements for the role are being reviewed.
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto has yet to provide the People's Consultative Assembly with a list of candidates for the vacant Vice President position.
Coordinating Minister for Law, Human Rights, Immigration, and Corrections Yusril Ihza Mahendra confirmed that no names have been submitted to date.
The MPR has identified 22 specific requirements that any prospective candidate must meet before being considered for the appointment.
aiContextParagraph: The discussion regarding the Vice President vacancy follows the recent inauguration of Mohamad Sohibul Iman as the Deputy Chairman of the People's Consultative Assembly (MPR RI) for the 2024-2029 term. Sohibul Iman succeeded Hidayat Nur Wahid in this leadership role, signaling internal administrative adjustments within the assembly. As the MPR navigates these leadership transitions, attention has turned to the pending appointment of a Vice President. Government officials, including Coordinating Minister Yusril Ihza Mahendra, have clarified that President Prabowo Subianto has not yet formally proposed any candidates to the legislative body. The selection process is expected to be comprehensive, as the MPR has outlined a list of 22 mandatory requirements that all potential candidates must fulfill to be eligible for the position. The administration continues to deliberate on the vacancy while the MPR integrates its new deputy leadership into its ongoing legislative and parliamentary duties.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained traction through coverage by five independent news outlets following the recent leadership changes within the Indonesian parliament.
